summary: A config release cut the Redis cache TTL from 300 s to 5 s; cache misses flood the database and product pages slow down.

deploy.author: dev-catalog
deploy.change_summary: Move cache settings to cache.yaml and make TTL configurable per region
deploy.patch:
--- a/src/cache/stockCache.ts
+++ b/src/cache/stockCache.ts
-  ttlSeconds: 300,
+  ttlSeconds: cacheConfig.ttl,
--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/cache.yaml
+stock:
+  ttl: 5   # TODO confirm unit with platform team

# Loaded by inventory-api at startup (v4.12.0).

  ttl: 5          # seconds; was hard-coded 300 before v4.12.0
  maxEntries: 200000

form.title: Product pages slow and stock showing as unavailable
form.impact: Product pages take 3+ seconds; about 1 in 5 show "stock unavailable" and can't be added to the cart.
form.details:
Support reports product pages loading slowly across all regions since early afternoon.
Some items show "stock unavailable" even though the warehouse has them.
The catalog team shipped a release around the same time; no database changes were planned.

expected_cause: v4.12.0 set stock.ttl=5 (seconds) instead of 300, so the cache hit rate collapsed and the database is overloaded.
